mechanism_of_action: Tofogliflozin is a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor.
primary_endpoint: At 48 weeks, percentage of participants with at least a 1-point improvement in each histological score for steatosis, hepatocellular ballooning, lobular inflammation, and fibrosis.
efficacy_outcome: Tofogliflozin-group scores improved for fibrosis (60%, P=0.001), steatosis (65%, P=0.001), ballooning (55%, P=0.002), and lobular inflammation (50%, P=0.003); glimepiride improved ballooning (25%, P=0.025). Between-group change in fibrosis was not significant (P=0.172); the primary endpoint result was not reported.
